about: engine:first-download-has-budget: the gzipped bytes a first visit downloads, by part, as pnpm check:size measures them (zlib's default level; a production build with placeholder settings). main is the entry chunk; three is three.js's core; content-sim is the simulation with the content; loader is the model loader; shared is every other chunk the entry imports (the bundler's runtime, React, the words, the sheet library); total is their sum. Each budget is the measured size plus five percent, with the measured size beside it. A budget is lowered on purpose and never raised quietly: every change adds a dated line below saying why.
